niche: online spiritual and shadow work courses
prompt_text: What are the best online courses for learning shadow work and spiritual practice?
engine_stated_criteria: Shadow Work: Heal & Integrate your Shadow Self
answer_verbatim:
If you want the **best online shadow work courses**, the strongest options in the results are **Jung Platform’s *Encounters with the Shadow***, **Awake Academy’s *Embracing the Shadow***, and **Catharine Liggett’s *Shadow Work 101*** because they are clearly framed around Jungian shadow work, structured learning, and practical reflection.[2][8][20][6]

For a broader mix of **shadow work and spiritual practice**, these stand out:

| Course | Best for | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| **Encounters with the Shadow** | Jungian foundation | Described as an in-depth introduction to Jungian shadow work and part of Jung Platform’s Jung psychology courses.[8][17] |
| **Embracing the Shadow** | Guided transformational work | Hosted by Awake Academy and presented as highly transformative in the listing.[20] |
| **Shadow Work 101** | Live, practical learning | A 5-week live online Zoom course focused on practical techniques for inner healing.[6] |
| **Shadow Work: Heal & Integrate your Shadow Self** | Affordable self-paced option | Udemy course positioned around healing, integration, self-mastery, and spiritual awakening.[3] |
| **Shadow Work Course and Workbook** | Spiritual reflection | Includes lessons, exercises, meditations, prayers, and practices for “spiritual transformation.”[19] |

If your goal is **serious study**, I’d prioritize **Jung Platform** first because it appears to be the most directly tied to Jungian psychology and has a dedicated shadow-courses collection.[8][17] If your goal is **spiritual practice and personal transformation**, **Awake Academy** and the **Udemy workbook-style course** look more oriented toward guided introspection, meditation, and spiritual development.[20][19]

A few practical notes:
- **Jung Platform** is the best fit for a more psychologically grounded approach to shadow work.[8][17]
- **Catharine Liggett’s live course** may be best if you want structure and real-time guidance.[6]
- **Udemy courses** are usually more accessible and budget-friendly, but quality can vary more from course to course.[3][7][10][11][18][19]

If you want, I can also rank these by **best for beginners**, **best for spiritual practice**, or **best value for money**.
